name: bangladesh-tenders-scraper
title: Bangladesh Government Tenders Scraper (CPTU/BPPA e-GP)
description: Scrapes Bangladesh's official national e-Government Procurement portal (eprocure.gov.bd, CPTU/BPPA) for live tender notices, awarded contracts (Notice of Award, with supplier name and value), and full per-tender detail pages with lot breakdown and document links. No login needed to browse.
